profile: The native namespace declaration profile and the checked ordinary heap table profile at the same release.
scope: An atomic schema declaration with one or more checked ordinary heap table declarations. Preserve their order and allow guarded repeat members.
structure: CreateSchema stores a detached ordered list of CreateTable children. CreateTable stores its absolute coordinates, checked ordered typed columns and local duplicate guard.
rules: The containing schema has a static decoded name, either written or supplied by a named owner. It cannot be guarded when elements are present.
Every child creates a heap table in the same absolute namespace and with the same grammar release as the parent.
Within the table phase the native command retains order. A later duplicate requires that member's IF NOT EXISTS. The skipped declaration does not replace the earlier heading or defaults.

Unqualified declared member names bind to the containing namespace. An explicitly qualified declaration must resolve to that same namespace. No member or local default may require an unresolved static reference.
The owner determines the namespace and all newly created table owners. The entire operation succeeds or fails atomically.
sql: Append each fully delimited CreateTable SQL form to its parent's declaration without semicolons. The parent retains its owner authorization, and each child retains its conditional, storage and ordered definitions.

finite.bound: 32 independent cells each for analyzed and direct construction per release. Full positive coverage is separate from native and typed refusals.

exploration.structure: Vary member list length and order, repeated table identity, member guard, table and column roles, literal defaults, quote and UTF-8 names, owner, qualification and transaction timing.

observations: Owner role, decoded absolute name, child release, member order and duplicate guard before publication.
Namespace and table owner, relation kind, heap access method, ordered field names, native types, nullability and expression defaults.
Defaults exercised by inserts, including NULL and Unicode text. An unrelated table with the same local name stays unchanged.
Native exact duplicate diagnostic, atomic failure and rollback.
negative: A direct guarded parent with table members
A child with another namespace or release
An implicit session-derived namespace with absolute child identities
An embedded ordinary view with a target outside the enclosing namespace.
edges: The standalone scope's previous refused ordinary table declaration becomes a positive comparison.
A quoted named owner supplies a static implicit namespace for a child.
An existing containing namespace causes a native duplicate error and leaves all existing relations unchanged.
faults: Reverse member order with a guarded repeat and different headings
Move a child target into the decoy namespace
open: Sequence, view, index, trigger, and GRANT phases. Schema-name computation from a session owner with subordinate elements.
trust: The checked CreateTable role and independently evaluated native schema/catalog observations
Exact publication and detached list checks
promotion: Observe the exact former ordinary-view refusal as an additional positive in postgres-schema-views-v2.json. Preserve all predecessor finite coordinates, seeds and required rejection totals.
